name: Dzukou Valley
source_label: Kohima District Administration — Helpline + Dzukou 2020-21 wildfire control room precedent (Viswema entry point)

fields.rescue_contact: Kohima Police Control Room: 7005986046 · NSDMA: 1070 · Fire: 0370-2222952

notes: Dzukou Valley trek base is Viswema village in Kohima district (~25-30 km from Kohima town); valley itself sits on Kohima/Manipur (Senapati) border. NO infrastructure inside the valley — no hospital, no pharmacy, no police station, no permanent stay. NHAK Kohima is the only govt tertiary ER on evacuation route. **Fire/wildfire risk flagged**: 2020-21 wildfires burned for 2 weeks; during that incident Kohima Police set up control room at Dzukou entry point in Viswema and two relay stations at Dzukou base camp (per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2020-21_Dzuko_Valley_wildfires + Outlook India) — NDRF + IAF helicopters + Kohima DFO led ops. So in fire/rescue scenarios the state activates Kohima police control room (7005986046) + DFO Kohima as command. NSDMA 1070 (state disaster mgmt toll-free, confirmed on https://mon.nic.in/helpline/) is the standing helpline. Mountain_rescue null because no permanent dedicated mountain rescue squad is published on any .nic.in page. local_police_station/police_address null — Viswema has no published outpost on Kohima district .nic.in directories. Pharmacy/mechanic/tow/guesthouse/EN-doctor not on any .nic.in page → null.
